theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_cycle_eval_le_radius_mul_mass
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)) (x₀ : Euclid P) (ϱ : ℝ), 0 < ϱ → X.boundary = 0 → X.mass < ∞ → X.support ⊆ closedBall x₀ ϱ → |X ω| ≤ c * ϱ * X.mass.toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
